name: Kandra
bio: As a young warrior, Kandra only wanted glory, not leadership. But when that responsibility was thrust upon her, Kandra grew into a selfless leader - a protector that loves her fighters more than the fight. She found her calling.

effects.label: Reflect Damage
effects.description: Reflects a certain percentage of incoming damage from the recipient, back to the attacker.Reflected damage ignores the attacker's DEF.

effects.label: Damage Filter
effects.description: Decreases the amount of damage the recipient takes from all attacks by the indicated amount. A 200 HP Damage Filter will decrease the damage from all incoming hits by 200.

effects.label: Deflection
effects.description: Redirects a percentage of all incoming damage from the recipient of the buff to the caster of the buff. The recipient takes the remainder of the damage as normal.

effects.label: Shield
effects.description: Gives the recipient a HP Shield. All damage the recipient takes will be subtracted from the Shield first, before their HP.Each Skill can only cast one Shield at a time on each recipient.
